options.label: AquaFlow CP-80 Gen2 (IE4 motor)
options.fit_notes: Meets 120 m3/h at 42 m (rated 130 m3/h at 44 m); same footprint.

options.label: Hydrix NB-100
options.fit_notes: Meets duty (rated 180 m3/h at 46 m) but oversized; new baseplate needed.

options.label: Repair current pump (bearing replacement)
options.fit_notes: Keeps the 9-year-old pump; 3 corrective repairs in the last 12 months.

options.label: Vortan Eco-75
options.fit_notes: Rated 110 m3/h at 38 m: below the 120 m3/h at 42 m duty.

justification: Replacing P-101 with the AquaFlow CP-80 Gen2 has the lowest 5-year cost at €142,559, against €201,654 for repairing the current pump. Most of the gap is energy (74% vs 60% efficiency) and downtime, since the current pump needed 3 corrective repairs in the last 12 months. The extra upfront cost pays back in about 15 months; the Vortan Eco-75 is cheaper to buy but cannot deliver 120 m3/h at 42 m.
